text.text: Building work is everywhere as the city grows. Sites often block pavements, pushing people around barriers and onto narrow, uncomfortable paths.
Hulhumalé’s roads are built for vehicles: wide streets, busy with cars and motorbikes. Drivers come first, and people on foot can feel unsafe at junctions and along busy roads.
Many routes have little continuous shade from trees, canopies or buildings. In the hot, humid climate, walking at midday is hard on the body.
